title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE SMOOTHER PARTY PLAY
why: The card was stamped v17.48. It now says what changed for playing together since: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS shows in the Undercroft and the lift joins the raid too (also after a window was closed and opened again), an open trade offer stays on screen, and THE OVERSEER is drawn to its size.
now: The what is new card names the smoother party play: drop-in from the Undercroft or the lift, the trade offer line, and the boss drawn to its size.

edits.anchor: 'TRADING, DROP-IN AND A BOSS. With the backpack open, T or Y offers the selected item to your teammate, who takes it with T or Y. A teammate in the Undercroft can JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS. THE OVERSEER guards the middle of every map. The stash has search and sort, Settings has Render resolution, Frame cap and Effects, and hits and deaths are animated.',
